learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge of the use and programming of computers, operating systems, databases and computer programs with applications in engineering.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Operating Systems, Networks and Programming Languages
Local Area Networks (LAN). The OSI model. Topologies: Ethernet
Codes for numerical and character representation
What an algorithm and a program are
Advanced data types: strings, lists, arrays and matrices
Data input/output. Keyboard, screen and files
Program statements: conditional, recursive and iterative statements
teaching_methods: Compulsory assignments of computer programs and programming exercises
assessment_rules: The final grade is numerical: 0-4.9 Fail, 5.0-6.9 Pass, 7.0-8.9 Good, 9.0-10 Excellent. Students must obtain a minimum mark of 5.0 in the final examination and a minimum average of 5.0 in practical activities (SE2), with at least 4.0 in individual practical activities, to pass the course. Attendance at practical activities (AF3) is compulsory, and their submission (SE2) is an essential requirement for assessment. Failure to comply with these requirements or missing more than 25% of classes may result in a grade of Not Assessed or failing the module.
